pages.text: Unhitch all draft animals, then push along the wagon’s length while standing on the ground. Push from behind to move forward, or from the front to reverse. Body and axle areas can be used.$(br2)Keep your feet grounded. Pushing also helps free a tipped wagon or one with unsupported wheels; continued pressure helps it settle upright.
A seated driver can steer while someone pushes.$(br2)Move the wagon roughly over the centre of a folded jack, then use the jack to restore it to blocks.
